confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Phu Quoc's pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and prices vary widely by beachfront location. Cocktail and wine are based on the local beer-to-bar price relationship. FX: 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 comes from a secondary site that republishes RBA data. I did not open the RBA F11.1 table to verify it, so the source_url is the RBA exchange-rates page where the figure should be checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis benchmarked against mainland Vietnamese beach cities such as Nha Trang and Da Nang, with an island and resort premium applied to dining and accommodation.
